responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible break-handling interface exposed to GNU Modula-2 programs. It specifies procedures to enable or disable Ctrl-C handling and to push or pop a stack of callback procedures that are invoked when an interrupt is caught, abstracting the underlying host signal implementation supplied by the companion C source file.
same_name_distinction: This file is the Modula-2 definition interface for Break, declaring the public procedures only; unlike the same-stem Break.c file, it contains no signal-handling code and instead exposes the API that the C source implements against the host SIGINT facilities.
